system.description:
You attempt to drain the mental power of a hostile creature you can see, making it more difficult for them to think clearly in the moment.

Select one hostile creature you can see within range, forcing them to make an Intelligence saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature takes 2d6 psychic damage.

Failure: Affected creature takes 3d6 psychic damage, and suffers a -2 penalty on all Intelligence based attacks, DC’s or checks until the end of their next turn.

Critical Failure: Same as Failure, but damage is increased to 6d6.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
